rule: computed ONLY from rows that carry an official source URL; n printed on every value; Holm-adjusted across this family of 7; values that could not be computed are absent rather than estimated

rows.label: Home points vs away points (same game, all 136 games of Weeks 1-9)
rows.cannot_be_used_for: Pricing a same-game parlay leg pair. Two points totals in one game share pace and weather, so this association is not a leg dependence and does not tell you the joint probability of two overs.

rows.label: Home margin vs game total (same game)
rows.cannot_be_used_for: Pricing a side+total same-game parlay directly. A raw correlation of realised outcomes is a descriptive property of finished games, not the conditional model needed to price a joint bet.

rows.label: Absolute margin vs game total (same game)
rows.cannot_be_used_for: Anything causal. This is the 'blowouts are high scoring' regularity, which is a description.

rows.label: QB passing yards vs own team points (same team-game, 146 QB-games from Next Gen Stats)
rows.cannot_be_used_for: A player-prop edge. It says passing volume travels with scoring; it does not give a distribution for a single player's yardage threshold, and no official prop line exists to price against.

rows.label: QB passing yards vs game total (same game)
rows.cannot_be_used_for: Pricing a QB-yards over against a game-total over as independent legs. They are positively associated, so treating them as independent UNDERSTATES the joint probability.

rows.label: QB passing yards vs opposing QB passing yards (same game)
rows.cannot_be_used_for: Independence of two QBs' props across a parlay. Game script makes them positively associated, so the product rule understates the joint probability.

rows.label: Week mean total vs week-to-week total spread
rows.cannot_be_used_for: Weather or slate effects that would make different games in one week dependent. Nine weeks is far too few to detect a small effect; absence of evidence here is not evidence of independence.

source_note: Each value cites one fetchable official page. C1-C3 and C7 are computed from the 136-game log (origination/data/games-2026-w1-w9.json), every row of which cites its own Week scores page; C4-C6 are computed from the Next Gen Stats passing transcription (origination/data/raw-ngs-passing-transcription.txt).

not_computed.what: player-prop correlation for a specific yardage threshold
not_computed.why: no official prop line or prop price exists in any retrieved official source, so there is no threshold to condition on
nfl.com publishes no same-game-parlay price; a correlation cannot manufacture one
official pregame depth order does not exist, so 'starter vs backup' is not a usable official variable; see the depth study
